scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @rplace/shared && npm run typecheck -w @rplace/shared && npm run typecheck -w @rplace/server && npm run typecheck -w @rplace/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @rplace/shared && npm run test -w @rplace/shared && npm run test -w @rplace/server && npm run test -w @rplace/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rplace/shared && npm run build -w @rplace/server && npm run build -w @rplace/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @rplace/shared && concurrently -n shared,server,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @rplace/shared" "npm run dev -w @rplace/server" "npm run dev -w @rplace/web"
